description: This file implements the CBC cipher mode for AWS cryptography, providing methods for encryption, initialization vector management, and related functionality within the AWS SDK.

classes.name: Cbc
classes.description: A class implementing the CBC cipher mode for AWS cryptography within the SDK, supporting IV management and encryption parameter retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the cipher with an IV and key size, validating IV length.

methods.name: getOpenSslName
methods.description: Returns the OpenSSL cipher name corresponding to the key size.

methods.name: getAesName
methods.description: Returns the string representation of this cipher mode.

methods.name: requiresPadding
methods.description: Indicates whether this cipher method requires padding.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Resets the IV to the original or throws an exception if seeking beyond support.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the IV based on the latest ciphertext block.
